_README: Every number here was measured on this cluster. 'source' names the file or log line it came from. Nothing in this file is an estimate; estimates are computed in the notebook and labelled as such.

memory_scaling.config: pure mamba3, d_model=640, 6 fused + 2 message + 1+1 book layers, d_state=128, chunk=64, vocab=2112, book=500, bsz=1, remat off, XLA preallocation disabled
memory_scaling.oom_cap_note: MEM_FRACTION 0.74 was in force for that probe
memory_scaling.remat_is_a_noop: REMAT=1 and REMAT=0 gave byte-identical peaks (18.02 / 35.71) and OOMed at the same point. init_Mamba3SSM has no remat parameter; build_backbone passes remat only at registry.py:310 (hybrid TransformerBlock), :421 (pure transformer), :441 (NSA). The recurrent trunk is never wrapped.

same_work_different_cut.note: every row does 1,000 messages per GPU per step

ctx2k_training_arms.setup: 2 nodes x 4 GH200, micro_bsz=1, msg_seq_len=2000 (52,000 tokens), K=10, effective batch 80 sequences, tokens/step 416,000
ctx2k_training_arms.accounting_defect: src/lob/train.py:376 gates the hardware correction on args.ssm_type == 'mamba3'. The hybrid launcher sets SSM_TYPE empty and selects the model through ARCHITECTURE=hybrid_mamba3, so the hybrid arm is charged correction=1.0 and the baseline 3.09. Their logged MFU differs by 3.09x for accounting reasons alone.

mfu_reference_75m.config: 75m mamba3, d_model=1024, 78,539,423 params, msg_seq_len=500 (13,000 tokens), single node 4x GH200, 1 sequence per GPU
